messages.content: ترجم كل وحدة إنجليزية إلى العربية الفصحى بدقة واكتمال، مع حفظ المعنى والأسماء والإشارات الكتابية. لا تضف أسماء أو معلومات غير موجودة في النص، ولا تكتب ملاحظات أو شروحاً. أخرج JSON مطابقاً للمخطط فقط. يجب أن تكون chapter وverse عددين صحيحين بأرقام 0-9، وأن يكون text_ar ترجمة الوحدة وحدها.

{"chapter":12,"verses":[{"chapter":12,"verse":1,"text":"After these three had finished singing hymns. did I Nahor (Neros) brother of Job sit down next to him, as he lay down."},{"chapter":12,"verse":2,"text":"And I heard the marvelous (great) things of the three daughters of my brother, one always succeeding the other amidst awful silence."},{"chapter":12,"verse":3,"text":"And I wrote down this book containing the hymns except the hymns and signs of the [holy] Word, for these were the great things of God."},{"chapter":12,"verse":4,"text":"And Job lay down from sickness on his couch, yet without pain and suffering, because his pain did not take strong hold of him on account of, the charm of the girdle which he had wound around himself."},{"chapter":12,"verse":5,"text":"But after three days Job saw the holy angels come for his soul, and instantly he rose and took the cithara and gave it to his daughter Day (Yemima)."}],"book_code":"TJOB"}

response_format: JSON schema with book_code and verses. Each item has integer chapter, integer verse, and Arabic text_ar. Return exactly source verse numbers 1,2,3,4,5 in this chapter.
